headline: Contract award for Raices Dual Language School construction, Bid# 2026-0006, and a $3,318,571.79 bond payment.
summary: The meeting covers a recommended contract award for the Raices Dual Language School construction. It also includes project updates for Central Falls High School and other projects, and a vote on $3,318,571.79 in outstanding bills.
items: School Building Committee update from Jordanna Ruggeri, CF School Committee Representative

Owner's Project Manager and Ai3 Architects project updates: Central Falls High School, Raices Dual Language School, and other projects (abatement and demolition, retaining wall, track and field replacement)
Review and vote on recommendation to award a contract for Bid# 2026-0006, Raices Dual Language School Construction Bid
School Building Committee revolving fund, potential vote, including 26/27 Revolving Fund Subcommittee update
Vote on payment of outstanding bills: Bond Series 2025 Requisition # 4, $3,318,571.79
